name: TRON Lightcycle Run
description: The most spectacular roller coaster in any Disney park worldwide — TRON Lightcycle Run launches riders on motorcycle-style vehicles through a breathtaking indoor-outdoor layout at 95 km/h under the iconic canopy structure. The fastest coaster at any Disney park globally and the crown jewel of Shanghai Disneyland. Min 102cm.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean Battle for Sunken Treasure
description: The most technologically advanced Pirates of the Caribbean ride ever built — guests board treasure galleons through stunning show scenes combining projection mapping, animatronics and physical sets in an experience that surpasses every other Pirates ride at any Disney park worldwide. No height requirement.

name: Soaring Over the Horizon
description: A breathtaking hang-glider simulator that lifts riders in front of an enormous IMAX dome screen for a sweeping flight over the most spectacular landscapes on Earth — from the Great Wall to the African savanna to the Swiss Alps. The most beloved family attraction at Shanghai Disneyland. Min 102cm.

name: Roaring Rapids
description: The most thrilling river rapids ride at any Disney park — circular rafts are swept through churning white water channels, past dramatic waterfalls and through the Adventure Isle wilderness. Guaranteed soaking on a hot Shanghai day. Min 102cm.

name: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train
description: A beautifully themed family coaster swinging through the diamond mine of the Seven Dwarfs — the most charming and family-friendly coaster at Shanghai Disneyland with stunning animatronic scenes and gentle thrills. Min 97cm.

name: Hyperspace Mountain
description: Classic Space Mountain reimagined as an X-Wing vs TIE Fighter Star Wars battle — indoor coaster through complete darkness with immersive Star Wars audio and visual effects throughout. Min 102cm.

name: Voyage to the Crystal Grotto
description: A magical boat journey through fantastical grottos and enchanted landscapes beneath Storybook Castle — the most uniquely Shanghai Disney experience featuring scenes from beloved fairy tales in a gentle and spectacular dark boat ride. No height requirement.

name: Enchanted Storybook Castle
description: The largest Disney castle ever built at 57 metres tall — the centrepiece of Shanghai Disneyland dwarfs every other Disney castle worldwide. Features multiple attractions inside including the Once Upon a Time Adventure walkthrough and Once Upon a Time dinner show. No height requirement.

name: Adventure Isle
description: An expansive wilderness-themed land featuring Roaring Rapids, Camp Discovery ropes course and the dramatic Arbor of the Explorer. The most immersive and physically large themed land at Shanghai Disneyland covering enormous ground with lush jungle scenery.

name: Camp Discovery
description: The largest ropes course at any Disney park — Camp Discovery is a multi-level aerial adventure playground in Adventure Isle with suspended bridges, climbing nets and aerial obstacles through the treetops. Minimum 112cm for high elements.

name: Rex Racer
description: A fun family coaster in Toy Story Land themed to Rex the dinosaur from Toy Story — gentle hills and turns make this the ideal starter coaster for young riders experiencing their first roller coaster. Min 81cm.

name: Buzz Lightyear Planet Rescue
description: Interactive ride where guests man laser cannons to defeat Emperor Zurg and rescue captured aliens — competitive scoring between vehicles makes it highly replayable. No height requirement.

name: Fantasia Carousel
description: A beautifully themed classic carousel in Fantasyland featuring stunning hand-painted horses and Disney character details — one of the most photographed and beloved family attractions at Shanghai Disneyland. Suitable for all ages.
